commands.help:
❓ *How to use*

Control Claude Code via Telegram with real-time streaming!

*Workflow:*
1. /start - Start stream session
2. Type your message/request
3. 📸 Send photos - Claude analyzes with vision
4. 🎤 Send audio - Saved locally
5. See real-time responses
6. Answer Y/N for approvals

*Basic Commands:*
/start - Start new session
/stop - Stop session
/status - View status
/help - This help
/lang - Change language

*Advanced Commands:*
/command - Execute Claude CLI with custom flags
/model - Switch Claude model (sonnet/opus/haiku)
/resume - Resume a previous session
/continue - Continue most recent conversation
/tools - Manage available tools
/permissions - Control permission mode

*Supported media:*
📸 Photos - Analysis with Claude vision
🎤 Audio/Voice - Automatic transcription via Whisper{whisperStatus}
